items.name: Al-Madar Open 2025
items.information: أهلا وسهلا بكم في ثاني مسابقة لعام ٢٠٢٥ ، والتي ستقام في مدارس المدار الدولية يومي ٧-٨ من شهر فبراير لعام ٢٠٢٥. العنوان: الأردن - عمان - الظهير - مدارس المدار الدولية - المبنى الأول - الطابق الأرضي. Welcome to Almadar Open 2025, an official Rubik's cube competition held in Almadar International Schools on 7th-8th of Febraury of 2025. Location: Jordan - Amman - Almadar International Schools - Naltshek St. - Bulding 1 - Ground floor.

items.name: Davis Weeknight February 2025
items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) # This competition is on a weekday! (Friday) All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
